# Floor Care and Chemical Safety Protocol: Building B Restorations
Facility: Harbor Point Health Center
Prepared By: Julia Santoro, Facilities Supervisor
Date: 04/14/2026
Target Area: Building B Ground Concourse and Outpatient Suites

## Approved Chemicals and Substrate Compatibility
| Product Code | Chemical Name | pH Level | Approved Substrate | Scrubber Pad Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CHEM-102 | Neutral Floor Cleaner | 7.0 | Polished Terrazzo | White Non-Abrasive |
| CHEM-204 | Alkaline Heavy Stripper | 13.0 | Vinyl Composite Tile (VCT) | Black High-Density |
| CHEM-301 | Acidic Descaler | 2.5 | Unglazed Ceramic Tile | Red Buffing |

## Mandatory Dilution and Mixing Rules
- Use the automated wall-mounted proportioner in Custodial Closet 104 for all dispensing.
- Fill solution tanks with cold tap water only; hot water accelerates hazardous vapor production.
- Under no circumstances combine CHEM-204 with acidic descalers or ammonia-based products.

## Task Instructions for Shift Leads Priya Yamamoto and Fatima Mahoney
- Inspect all power cords and ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) plugs on the Pacific 20-inch auto-scrubber before operation.
- Post yellow wet-floor warning signs at every corridor entrance 50 feet ahead of cleaning.
- Dispense CHEM-204 at the specified 1:4 ratio to strip the sealed terrazzo in the main lobby.
- Run the Clarke rotary machine at 175 RPM across the administrative VCT corridors using the neutral pH formulation CHEM-204 to prevent finish damage.
- Double-rinse all treated ceramic surfaces with clean cold water to prevent residual tracking into adjoining carpet zones.

errors.quote: Dispense CHEM-204 at the specified 1:4 ratio to strip the sealed terrazzo in the main lobby.
errors.explanation: The compatibility table specifically lists CHEM-204 as approved only for Vinyl Composite Tile (VCT), while polished terrazzo requires CHEM-102. Applying an aggressive alkaline stripper (pH 13.0) to terrazzo can etch and ruin the stone matrix.
errors.fix: Dispense CHEM-102 at the specified 1:4 ratio to clean the sealed terrazzo in the main lobby.

errors.quote: using the neutral pH formulation CHEM-204 to prevent finish damage.
errors.explanation: The reference table shows CHEM-204 has a pH of 13.0 (alkaline heavy stripper), directly contradicting the statement that it is a neutral pH formulation. CHEM-102 is the neutral pH formulation (pH 7.0).
errors.fix: using the neutral pH formulation CHEM-102 to prevent finish damage.
